# Vendored Gemini detector

This directory contains the Gemini visible-sparkle detector and its two detection
templates copied from `lana-info/remove-ai-watermarks` at commit
`190dc89d234fd7e3a61ff755f01251c9c0b87ef0`.

The upstream project is licensed under Apache License 2.0. Its license text is
included as `LICENSE`. Only the detector and required templates are vendored; the
upstream removal engines and model weights are not included.
